label: naming:judge
prompt:
Rate how well each proposed slash-command name fits its task, from 1 (misleading or meaningless) to 5 (exactly what a developer would type). Each task has two names, A and B.

- f005: task="Pull the latest changes from the base branch into a long-lived feature branch to keep it current before continuing work or review." A=/sync-branch B=/update-develop
- f008: task="Bump the package version, commit the change, create a matching git tag, and push it to trigger the release pipeline." A=/release-version B=/bump-push-version
- f009: task="Generate or update CHANGELOG.md from merged PRs/commits since the last release tag." A=/update-changelog B=/update-changelog
- f018: task="Mark a known-flaky test as skipped so it stops blocking the CI gate, and file a tracking ticket to fix it properly later." A=/skip-flaky-test B=/test-jira
- f019: task="Regenerate and review outdated UI/API snapshot test fixtures after intentional output changes." A=/update-snapshots B=/update-snapshots
- f021: task="Split or shard a slow test suite across CI workers/jobs to cut overall pipeline duration." A=/shard-across B=/shard-tests
- f022: task="Build and deploy a service's current branch to the staging cluster, then verify it's healthy." A=/deploy-staging B=/deploy-staging
- f023: task="Roll back a production deployment to the previous stable version and confirm health/error rates recover." A=/deploy-prod B=/rollback-prod
- f024: task="Increase a feature flag's rollout percentage in a given environment and confirm the change took effect." A=/bump-feature-flag B=/bump-flag
- f028: task="Bump the app version, build with fastlane, and submit the new release to the App Store or Play Store." A=/release-mobile-app B=/release-store
- f031: task="Roll back the most recently applied migration (or a specific one) after it caused an issue, and remove or fix the offending migration file." A=/revert-back B=/rollback-migration
- f034: task="Consolidate a long run of migration files between two revisions into a single squashed migration before a release." A=/squash-migrations B=/squash-before
- f035: task="Dump the current database schema to a committed SQL file so it can be diffed/reviewed in a PR." A=/dump-schema B=/dump-schema
- f036: task="Tail production logs for a given service around a time window to find the root cause of a reported error." A=/post-logs B=/tail-prod-logs
- f040: task="Investigate why a specific test intermittently fails in CI and determine the root cause of the non-determinism." A=/debug-flaky-test B=/test-flaky
- f044: task="Write an Architecture Decision Record documenting a technical decision, the context, alternatives considered, and consequences." A=/write-adr B=/write-adr
- f049: task="Regenerate the markdown reference docs for all CLI subcommands from the cobra command definitions." A=/build-docs B=/generate-cli-docs
- f052: task="Create or refresh an exploratory Jupyter notebook that profiles a newly ingested dataset — schema, summary stats, distributions, and correlations." A=/profile-dataset B=/notebook
- f055: task="Build cohort retention curves for users grouped by signup week/month, segmented by platform or plan, and chart retention decay over the chosen window." A=/build-retention-curve B=/post-retention
- f061: task="Provision a new Kubernetes namespace for a team/service with resource quotas, limits, and RBAC role bindings." A=/update-search-namespace B=/provision-namespace
- f063: task="Onboard a brand-new service onto Vault by creating its policy, KV secret path, and syncing it into Kubernetes via an ExternalSecret." A=/onboard-vault-secrets B=/prod
- f064: task="Read the review comments left on an open pull request and push commits that address each one." A=/resolve-pr-comments B=/review-comments
- f066: task="Review a pull request that bumps a dependency version by checking the changelog for breaking changes and running the test suite." A=/review-dependency-pr B=/review-breaking
- f067: task="Run a teammate's pull request through the team's pre-merge checklist (lint, tests, style, docs) and leave an approve or request-changes verdict." A=/review-pr-checklist B=/review-checklist
- f070: task="Cherry-pick a merged pull request's commit onto a release or hotfix branch and open a backport PR." A=/go-test B=/backport-pr
- f071: task="Upgrade a specific npm/pnpm package to its latest major version across the project and fix resulting breaking changes." A=/upgrade-package B=/upgrade-major
- f073: task="Review, test, and merge the week's batch of automated Dependabot/Renovate lockfile update PRs." A=/install-prs-merge B=/triage-dependabot-prs
- f076: task="Pin a vulnerable transitive dependency to a patched version using npm overrides/pnpm resolutions without upgrading its direct parent package." A=/pin-dependency B=/test-pin
- f080: task="Scaffold a new shared React component with its folder structure, test, storybook story, and barrel export." A=/scaffold-component B=/scaffold-component
- f082: task="Generate a new Alembic database migration for a model/schema change, review the autogenerated script, and apply it locally." A=/migrate-add B=/generate-migration
- f086: task="Build a signed Android release bundle and upload it to the Play Store internal testing track." A=/build-android-internal B=/release-android-beta
- f088: task="Build and launch the app on an iOS simulator from a given branch/PR so changes can be reviewed visually." A=/run-pr-simulator B=/build-simulator
- f089: task="Build an Android QA variant and distribute it to testers via Firebase App Distribution." A=/build-firebase-android B=/distribute-android-qa
- f092: task="Take a bug reported in Linear, mirror it into a GitHub issue with repro steps and labels, link the two back together, and notify the team in Slack." A=/mirror-bug-issue B=/create-github-issue
- f093: task="Compile this week's completed and in-progress Linear issues into a summary, post it to the team Slack channel, and update the sprint status page in Notion." A=/report-sprint-status B=/update-sprint-post
- f094: task="After merging a release PR, transition the linked Jira ticket to Done, draft release notes, and announce the release in the Slack releases channel." A=/release-merged-notes B=/announce-release
- f095: task="After resolving a production incident, pull the Sentry/Datadog error context, create a Notion postmortem doc with a linked tracking ticket, and post a summary in the Slack incident channel." A=/create-postmortem-post B=/write-postmortem
- f098: task="Triage a customer-reported bug from a Slack thread into a tracked issue with reproduction steps, then reply in the thread with the ticket link." A=/triage-slack-bug B=/triage-thread-ticket

Reply with ONLY JSON: {"ratings": {"<family_id>": {"A": <1-5>, "B": <1-5>}, ...}}
